props.title: See every request as it happens
props.description: Real-time metrics and data streams for every application, on the platform itself. Nothing to configure, no storage to attach.

tabs.title: Error rate
tabs.description: Spot a spike the moment it starts, on the path that caused it, with the events behind it one click away.
tabs.illustrationLabel: A Real-Time Metrics panel: the error rate of /api/checkout rising to 42 percent

tabs.title: Status codes
tabs.description: Every response code by host and path across the week, so a burst of 429s stands out.
tabs.illustrationLabel: A Real-Time Metrics panel: 429 status codes by host and path, Monday to Friday

tabs.title: Data streams
tabs.description: The same events sent on to your SIEM, dashboards and APIs in under 40 seconds.
tabs.illustrationLabel: A data stream from Azion to APIs and GraphQL, dashboards, SIEM and interfaces
